message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"The retrieved passages collectively describe Uber's revenue model as outlined in the IPO prospectus: Core Platform (Ridesharing revenue from service and booking fees; Uber Eats revenue from service fees; Other revenue from Vehicle Solutions), and Other Bets (Uber Freight revenue from pre-determined per-shipment fees; New Mobility revenue from consumer ride fees for dockless bikes/scooters). The passages contain explicit sentences defining each revenue stream, matching the requested level of detail.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Ridesharing revenue comes from service and booking fees paid by Drivers for the use of the platform.","passage_rank":4,"quote":"\"We generate Ridesharing revenue from service and booking fees paid by Drivers for the use of our platform to connect with consumers in need of transportation and complete Ridesharing services.\""},{"requirement":"Uber Eats revenue comes from service fees paid by restaurants and Drivers for use of the platform (delivery-related fees).","passage_rank":4,"quote":"\"We generate Uber Eats revenue from service fees paid by restaurants and Drivers for use of our platform to provide a meal or complete a meal delivery.\""},{"requirement":"Other revenue includes Vehicle Solutions activities.","passage_rank":4,"quote":"\"Other revenue primarily consists of revenue associated with our Vehicle Solutions activities.\""},{"requirement":"Uber Freight revenue is generated from shippers paying a predetermined per-shipment fee for the brokerage service.","passage_rank":2,"quote":"\"Other Bets • Uber Freight. Other Bets primarily consists of Uber Freight, ... We generate revenue from our Uber Freight offerings from shippers that pay us a pre-determined fee for each shipment to use our brokerage service.\""},{"requirement":"New Mobility revenue is generated from fees charged to consumers for a ride on a dockless e-bike or e-scooter.","passage_rank":2,"quote":"\"Revenue is generated through fees charged to consumers for a ride on a dockless e-bike or e-scooter.\""}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
